prompts: Redraw one transparent sprite sheet for Lina Seabright, the exact purple-haired sailor fighter in the input. She is unarmed. Use a regular invisible 3-column by 2-row grid of six equal square cells. Exactly one complete 2D game sprite per cell, same character size and hip x in every cell. Natural walking, not running. Read the grid left to right, top to bottom. (2) top middle, right foot planted under weight, far left knee bends and left heel lifts behind. (3) top right, far left foot swings through just past near right foot, knee bent, left foot slightly airborne, right foot planted. (4) bottom left, far LEFT leg strides FORWARD toward screen right, left heel touching down, near RIGHT thigh with anchor extends BACK toward screen left, right heel raised. (5) bottom middle, far left foot planted under weight, near right knee bends and right heel lifts behind. Keep the character and weapon scale fixed and leave more margin if needed. Correct near/far layering: the near right arm and near right leg are in front of the torso and far limbs; the far left arm and leg stay behind. No interpenetration, no merged or extra limbs, no floating parts and no duplicated weapon. Both feet and toes point toward screen right. Do not mirror the art.

Right-facing three-quarter side view, accurate near/far anatomical layering, no merged limbs, no interpenetration, no floating parts. Preserve exact head, body and boot size in all frames. Centering may only use translation, no zoom, scaling or stretching. Render complete silhouettes with generous clear gap.
